missing_elements: Severity/Priority: No explicit severity or priority classification (e.g., Critical/Major) with rationale beyond impact narrative

quality_issues.quote: Use a gather image/command that fails or exits early (or simulate gather crash)
quality_issues.suggestion: Provide a concrete gather image override or command snippet (e.g., a MustGather CR YAML with a failing gather command) so reproducers do not need to invent a failure scenario.

quality_issues.quote: How reproducible: Always (by design of current upload coordination)
quality_issues.suggestion: Clarify whether reproduction requires a live OpenShift cluster with SFTP credentials or whether PVC-only obfuscation paths can be verified without SFTP access.

non_blockers: No explicit OpenShift or operator version in environment details — add affected release(s) if known
No sample upload-container or gather-container log excerpts — include representative log lines showing pgrep debounce followed by upload despite gather failure
No original development PR URLs linked — optional for triage but useful for ARD extraction in bug-report stage
